script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: second chances

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. FUTURISTIC APARTMENT - NIGHT

A rain-soaked cityscape illuminates through the large glass windows of this sleek, modern apartment. The aroma of steaming dinner wafts from the kitchen.

SAM (early 40s, disheveled, wearing a rumpled shirt) sits at the kitchen table, staring blankly at the half-eaten plate of food in front of him.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Once a brilliant scientist, Sam's latest experiment went horribly wrong, taking the lives of three people and destroying his reputation.

INT. APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Sam's holographic device flickers to life, displaying an image of EVA (early 30s, polished, and determined).

EVA (on hologram)
Sam, I've secured you a second chance. You'll be working for me at Project Renaissance.

SAM
A second chance for what? I can't undo the past.

EVA
No, but you can create a better future. Join me, and together, we'll change the world.

INT. PROJECT RENAISSANCE LABORATORY - DAY

Sam arrives at the Project Renaissance facility, his heart heavy but filled with hope. He's greeted by DR. KWON (40s, focused, and welcoming), the project leader.

DR. KWON
Welcome, Sam. We're glad to have you on board. Our team is working on some groundbreaking technologies.

INT. PROJECT RENAISSANCE LABORATORY - EVENING

Sam works alongside his colleagues, including LUCAS (late 20s, sociable, and curious) and ANA (mid 30s, methodical, and empathetic). They all share a passion for innovation and a desire to make amends for past mistakes.

INT. APARTMENT KITCHEN - NIGHT

Sam cooks dinner for Eva, who joins him for a quiet meal. They share stories of their pasts, their hopes for the future, and the possibility of redemption.

EVA
Sam, you have a unique opportunity to make things right. Don't let it slip away.

INT. PROJECT RENAISSANCE CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY

Sam and his team present their latest innovation: a device that converts carbon emissions into clean energy. Their work captures the attention of the world, and Sam's reputation is restored.

INT. FUTURISTIC APARTMENT - NIGHT

Sam stands at the balcony, gazing at the cityscape, a contented smile on his face. He's made amends, and he's ready to create a better future.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Second chances are rare, but with determination, hard work, and the support of those around us, we can make the most of them.

FADE OUT.
